name: How does architectural planning handle permitting for ADUs in specific cities?
description: Architectural planning ensures ADU designs comply with specific city building codes and zoning ordinances to facilitate permit approval.

mainEntity.name: How does architectural planning handle permitting for ADUs in specific cities?

acceptedAnswer.text: Architectural planning addresses permitting by ensuring designs comply with the specific building codes and zoning ordinances of your city, whether it's Oakland, Berkeley, or another location in our service area. Each municipality can have unique requirements regarding setbacks, height limits, parking, and utility connections. Our team drafts plans that anticipate and meet these local mandates, streamlining the submission and approval process with the relevant city planning department.
